# Data retention policy

## 1. Purpose

This policy establishes the periods for which the Company retains personal data collected through
its services, and the process by which data is deleted once those periods lapse. It applies to all
employees, contractors, and systems that process personal data on the Company's behalf.

## 2. Definitions

"Personal data" means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.
"Processing" means any operation performed on personal data, including collection, storage, and
deletion. "Retention period" means the length of time a category of personal data is kept before
deletion or anonymization.

## 3. Retention periods

Account data shall be retained for the duration of the customer relationship and for 90 days after
account closure, to permit reactivation. Billing records shall be retained for seven years, as
required by applicable tax law. Support communications shall be retained for two years from the
date of the last message in a given thread. Where a longer period is required by a specific legal
obligation, that longer period shall govern.

## 4. Deletion process

Upon expiry of the applicable retention period, the responsible system owner shall initiate deletion
within 30 days. Deletion shall be logged, and the log entry shall record the data category, the
retention period applied, and the date of deletion. Backups containing expired data shall be
purged in accordance with the backup rotation schedule set out in Appendix B.

## 5. Exceptions

Data subject to a litigation hold, a regulatory inquiry, or an active legal obligation shall not be
deleted until that hold or obligation is lifted. The Legal department shall maintain a record of all
active holds and shall notify the relevant system owner promptly upon release.
